hypotheses.justification: B appears neither in the conclusion nor in any other binder; the proof uses it only through gammaInf/rhoInf/bijective_option. A BezoutData M ℓ (integers u, v with u*ℓ + v*M = 1) can be built from ρ and hρ. Since ρ ∈ Gamma0 M, Gamma0_mem gives (ρ 1 0 : ZMod M) = 0. The determinant gives ρ00*ρ11 - ρ01*ρ10 = 1. Casting to ZMod M and using hρ (ρ11 ≡ ℓ) gives (ρ00 : ZMod M) * ℓ = 1. By ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd, (M:ℤ) ∣ ρ00*ℓ - 1, say ρ00*ℓ - 1 = M*w. Then ⟨ρ00, -w, _⟩ : BezoutData M ℓ. So the proof starts by building this B locally and then runs unchanged. NeZero M rules out M = 0, and M = 1 needs no special treatment.
